description:
Every planning designation affecting a location, in one call: conservation
    area, listed building, green belt, AONB, national park, flood zone,
    Article 4, brownfield, ancient woodland, heritage at risk, TPO, AQMA and
    scheduled monument.

    Give either `postcode` (full UK postcode) or `location` as "lat,lng".
    UK only. Free.
name: planning_designations
title: Planning designations at a location
